Home.title: Explore Dien Chan on a 3D face
Home.subtitle: Locate the points on the face and follow stimulation routines step by step, organised by pain or condition.
Home.feature1Text: Rotate the face, zoom and switch views: front, left profile, right profile.
Home.feature2Text: Pick a pain or a condition: the routine appears and animates point by point on the face.
Home.feature3Text: Each step tells you how long or how many times to stimulate the point, with a signal at the end.
Home.notice: Dien Chan is a complementary practice. It does not replace medical advice.
